schemaVersion.$comment: v2 (2026-07-16, decision 2026-07-16-review-verdict-closure) adds the REVISE-closure relation fields below. v1 events remain valid; closure semantics are evaluated over the typed v2 fields. This is the MINIMAL slice (fable step-back gate): anchor/migration machinery, reconcilesRunIds, blobDigest, protectedLane, reviewScope are DEFERRED until an observed incident or telemetry funds them.

executionRole.$comment: Exactly ONE main-conversation identity: 'main' (the main conversation, which also holds the Lead role — orchestration weight lives in status.md 'orchestration: light|full-lead', never here). Ledgers written before 2026-07-11 may carry the legacy value 'lead'; readers map it to 'main' (see scripts/validate-work-item-state.py LEGACY_EXECUTION_ROLES). New writes must use 'main'.

gate.$comment: WAIVED:user (v2): typed user-authorized terminal disposition for open REVISE obligations — requires status 'completed', non-empty closesRunIds, and a manual-check evidence entry carrying the user's explicit authorization; never legal against a protected findingClass (publication-safety/security), whose only non-PASS discharge authority is the $security-reviewer (see the decision record).

eventKind.$comment: v2 lifecycle discriminator: 'launch' = a dispatch record (external run started); 'terminal' = its settlement (requires launchRunId); 'standalone' = an event that is not part of a launch/terminal pair (verdicts recorded directly, planning notes).

launchRunId.$comment: On a terminal event: the runId of the launch event it settles.

closesRunIds.$comment: The normalized REVISE-closure relation (decision item 2): the exact runIds of earlier gate:REVISE events this PASS/WAIVED:user event discharges. Closure is NEVER derived from role/scope/artifact string matching.

artifactRevision.$comment: Revision of the reviewed artifact at review time (plain string in the minimal slice: a git sha or content digest; mechanical git-object/blob verification is deferred).

lane.$comment: Review angle label (e.g. 'architecture-adversarial'). Closure requires lane equality when both sides carry it; new review events SHOULD carry it.

effort.$comment: Typed declared reasoning-effort tier. When both a REVISE and its closer declare effort and share a provider, the closer's tier must be >= the target's.

findingClass.$comment: Classification of a REVISE finding. publication-safety and security are NON-USER-WAIVABLE: WAIVED:user against them is invalid (spine: only $security-reviewer approves a publication-safety exception).
